output_list.criticism: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the 'totalSupply' of an attacker's address to a large value, aka 'minting attack'. 'mintedAmount' is of type uint256, also known as Big Integer, allowing it to exceed the maximum value of 2^256-1, aka 'Wong Logic'.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the 'balanceOf' of an attacker's address to a large value, aka 'minting attack'. 'balanceOf[_to]' is added with _value, if _value is very large, it will cause integer overflow and 'balanceOf[_to]' becomes a small value, aka 'Wong Logic'.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the 'balanceOf' of an attacker's address to a large value, aka 'minting attack'. 'balanceOf[_to]' is added with _value, if _value is very large, it will cause integer overflow and 'balanceOf[_to]' becomes a small value, aka 'Wong Logic'.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the 'balanceOf' of an attacker's address to a large value, aka 'minting attack'. 'balanceOf[from]' is subtracted by _value, if _value is very large, it will cause integer overflow and 'balanceOf[from]' becomes a small value, aka 'Wong Logic'.
The smart contract does not have 'Undefined' vulnerability, aka 'Bad Output'.
